name: The Smell of Greatness
startText:
[sleepy] Anthony woke next to a pile of dung, stiff and thirsty and a with list of chores from his wife. 
[annoyed]Seven years of farming, and he still wondered why the gods had given him such powerful arms if all they were meant to do was carry manure.
[dreamy] [yawn] He just dreamt of the army where,[pause] a man could win glory, see the world [enthousiastic]and eat at somebody else's expense.
For now, there was wood to chop, a hill to climb, and two useless scarecrows to deal with.
[determined][aaah]A hero had to start somewhere.
winText:
[proud]Two scarecrows lay in the dirt, and Anthony's fields were once again free of imaginary foes. 
He rested beneath a tree, rather pleased with the morning's work. It was the most fighting he'd done in years.

[dreamy]Perhaps soldiering would suit him after all.
loseText: The scarecrows remain unimpressed. Move, climb, and keep an eye on your energy. Even a man destined for greatness must occasionally stop to catch his breath.

tokens.text: Anthony is low on [energy] and [hp], stomac empty and head fuzzy from last night out. Now he is going to teach those scarecrows what it means to be scared. [tutorial]
Climbing up the hill will use some energy [energy]. Press [rest] to recover if you have not enough energy. [tutorial]
Running off heigher ground will give you a +1 on your movement without using extra energy.

Note from the creator: This is not this kind of game where your first activity is chopping down trees with your bare fist to build tools. Nice try though. However, you did learn you can break thinks with enough resolve!
